title: Recipe 64 — The self-teaching expert (memory, curriculum, and a living exam)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Most agents forget everything between sessions. This one keeps a curriculum and grades itself against it.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed expert is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the credentials
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — THREDZ_API_KEY for the hosted wiki, plus the model credential.

beats.label: Open the committed expert
beats.cue: “Memory, a wiki store, and a heartbeat. The heartbeat is what makes it study when nobody's asking.”

beats.label: Lint it in place
beats.cue: “Clean — the whole learning loop is declared, not scripted.”

beats.label: Type the wiki-store line
beats.cue: “`thredz: true` is shorthand for the hosted store. One line, and the agent has somewhere durable to write what it learns.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Swap it for a local path and nothing else in the spec changes.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The curriculum and the wiki are IR nodes. Learning is part of the shape, not a library the agent imports.”

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “Read the memory and knowledge nodes — that's the whole studying apparatus.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, and the gate it stops at is the MCP server credential the spec itself declares. A named gate, not a failure.”

verify.note: GREEN — boot gated (boot reached its MCP server credentials gate: THREDZ_API_KEY)

beats.label: Type the heartbeat block
beats.cue: “study/reflect on a schedule. This is what turns a chat agent into something that gets better while you sleep.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “An interval and a task. Cheap to declare, and the entire difference between static and self-teaching.”

beats.label: Look for the exam
beats.cue: “The 'living exam' is a registered dataset — empty here, because it's earned from real sessions.”

verify.note: no datasets registered yet — the honest starting state

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “You can't grade an expert against an exam it hasn't sat yet.”

groups.title: One more thing · teach it something

beats.label: Run the expert
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Ask it something outside what it knows, and watch it log the gap rather than bluff.”

verify.note: needs THREDZ_API_KEY and a model credential

beats.label: Ask past the edge of its knowledge
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The logged gap becomes tomorrow's curriculum entry. That's the loop.”
beats.text: What changed in our refund policy last quarter?

beats.label: Turn the flywheel on what it learned
beats.cue: [needs-key] “learn what to learn → study → get examined → optimize. Recipe 56's loop, pointed at a curriculum.”

verify.note: needs a registered dataset and a model credential; billed
